label: 18 Ops Timeout Reconnect
info:
PATTERN: Ops — timeout, logs, reconnect

FEATURES IN THIS FLOW
- Client with failure/state-oriented logging enabled
- Flex-Getter polling Holding Registers
- Comment describes how to disturb and recover the local server
- Teaches 5.60.1+ reconnect honesty (Timed out / network blips)

WHAT THE CONFIG DOES
- reconnectOnTimeout=true, clientTimeout=1000, reconnectTimeout=2000
- failureLogEnabled / showErrors for visibility
- emptyMsgOnFail on Flex-Getter optional for downstream handling
- Demo server on 10519

HOW TO RUN
1) Deploy; wait until client active and SEE: values update
2) Disable the Modbus-Server node and Deploy (or stop binding briefly)
3) Observe timeout / inactive behaviour in status and Debug
4) Re-enable the Modbus-Server and Deploy
5) Confirm Flex-Getter recovers without restarting Node-RED

Demo TCP port: 10519

Config nodes are flow-scoped: delete this tab to remove client/IO config.
